# sidecar.detect_lonlat_columns { #healpyxel.sidecar.detect_lonlat_columns }

```python
sidecar.detect_lonlat_columns(gdf_sample)
```

Auto-detect longitude and latitude columns from a DataFrame sample.

Scans column names (case-insensitive) against common patterns for
longitude and latitude fields. Returns the first match for each.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                             | Description                                           | Default    |
|------------|----------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| gdf_sample | pd.DataFrame or gpd.GeoDataFrame | Sample DataFrame to inspect for column name patterns. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                              | Description                                                                                                          |
|--------|-----------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | tuple\[str \| None, str \| None\] | ``(lon_column, lat_column)`` or ``(None, None)`` if not found. Column names are returned with their original casing. |
